img_129.description: Large circular diagram with three concentric bands of figures. Central medallion shows two fish with a star above and below; around it rings of small human figures standing in striped or chequered tubs/barrels, each holding a star on a string, with short labels beside each and lines of script running round the ring borders. Some barrels are painted green.
img_129.central_figure: Two fish, one above the other, the lower one on a long blue curved line (like a cord or water)
img_129.sign_reason: Two fish in the centre is the standard picture of Pisces
img_129.rings: Central medallion, an inner ring of figures (some with green barrels) bounded by a band of hatched marks, and an outer ring of figures; text written along the circle lines and as labels beside figures
img_129.figure_details: Mostly busts or half-figures emerging from tubs or barrels with striped, chequered or dotted patterns; some barrels green; several figures wear blue head-caps; each holds a star by a thread; some inverted because they are drawn radially
img_129.celestial_objects: One star per figure (about 30 eight-pointed stars) plus two stars in the centre; no sun or moon
img_129.groupings: Roughly 10 figures in inner ring and 20 in outer ring
img_129.astro_concept: Thirty figures each with one star around one sign suggests the 30 degrees of the sign (or 30 days of the month the sun is in it); alternatively the individual stars of the constellation
img_129.other: Hatched band between inner and outer rings is unusual; text appears in an unknown script

img_896.description: Circular diagram on a page near the book's spine (edge of the binding visible on the left). Centre: a horned, bearded four-legged animal on a light blue mound, reaching up to a green bush. Two rings of clothed figures, many in tubs, each holding a star; labels beside them; text along ring borders. Brown stain near the inner ring.
img_896.central_figure: A goat-like horned animal with beard eating from a green bush, standing on a small blue-outlined mound
img_896.sign_reason: Horned caprine animal (ram/goat) on land with no fish tail, so not a sea-goat Capricorn; ram is the closer fit, but it looks goat-like so Capricorn is not excluded
img_896.rings: Central medallion, inner ring with about 5 figures, outer ring with about 10 figures; text bands on the circle lines
img_896.figure_details: Mostly clothed women in robes or dresses, some emerging from tubs with patterned (scale, circle, striped) surfaces, one green-striped tub; each holds a star on a string; several drawn radially, upside down at the bottom
img_896.celestial_objects: About 15 stars, one per figure; no sun or moon
img_896.astro_concept: Fifteen figures could be half of the sign's 30 degrees (the other half on a companion page) or days of a half-month
img_896.other: Text in an unknown script; diagram cut off at the right edge

img_806.description: Circular diagram on a left-hand page close to the spine. Centre: a clothed man in a blue tunic and hat aiming a crossbow. Two or three rings of nude female figures with stars, labels beside them, text along the rings. Further nude figures in a band at the top of the page partly beyond the circle. Green paint smudges.
img_806.central_figure: A man in a blue tunic and broad hat holding a crossbow
img_806.sign_reason: The archer of Sagittarius, shown as a man with a crossbow instead of a centaur with a bow
img_806.rings: Central medallion with text circling it, inner ring of figures, outer ring of figures, and an extra arc of figures across the top
img_806.figure_details: Nude women standing, reclining or drawn radially, some wearing crowns or headdresses; no tubs visible; each linked to a star
img_806.celestial_objects: About 30 stars, one per figure; no sun or moon
img_806.groupings: Inner and outer rings, plus top arc
img_806.astro_concept: About 30 figures with one star each suggests the 30 degrees of the sign or days of the month
img_806.other: Masked patches near the top and at the figure's feet

img_477.description: Circular diagram on a right-hand page; part of another similar diagram visible on the left. Centre: a seated figure in a blue-striped gown with a cap, holding something, with a small flower near the lower left. Rings of nude female figures standing and lying, each with a star; text bands and labels.
img_477.central_figure: A seated person in a long blue-patterned gown and blue cap, holding an object (partly masked); a small flower beside them
img_477.sign_reason: A single dressed seated figure, apparently female, with a flower is the usual depiction of the Virgin; but the figure could be read as male and the hand area is masked
img_477.rings: Central medallion with circular text, inner ring of figures, outer ring of figures; text on borders
img_477.figure_details: Nude women, some standing upright at the top, others lying around the circle radially; no tubs; each holds or touches a star
img_477.celestial_objects: About 30 stars; no sun or moon
img_477.groupings: Inner ring about 10, outer ring about 20
img_477.astro_concept: About 30 star-holding figures: degrees of the sign or days of the month
img_477.other: A second circular diagram is partly visible on the left side of the image

img_941.description: Circular diagram on a full page. Centre: a pink-red horned four-legged animal facing a basket filled with green, on a green ground line. Two rings of clothed figures in red/pink clothing with green hats, many emerging from tubs, each holding a star on a string; labels and text bands.
img_941.central_figure: A pinkish horned animal with cloven hooves and tail, feeding from a basket of green fodder
img_941.sign_reason: A horned cloven-hoofed animal fed from a basket, body heavy like a bull; horns are curved and could be a ram's, so Aries is possible
img_941.rings: Central medallion, inner ring about 5 figures, outer ring about 10 figures, text on borders
img_941.figure_details: Clothed figures in red/pink garments, several with green round hats or caps, emerging from tubs (one tub with arches); each holds a star; lower figures drawn upside down
img_941.celestial_objects: About 15 stars, one per figure; no sun or moon
img_941.astro_concept: Fifteen figures: half a sign's 30 degrees, or half a month, possibly continued on a companion diagram

img_396.description: Circular diagram on a left-hand page; more nude figures in an arc at the top. Centre: a small dark green four-legged creature with an upturned curled tail and open snout, under a large star. Rings of nude female figures with stars, labels, and text bands.
img_396.central_figure: A green lizard- or salamander-like four-legged animal with a curled raised tail
img_396.sign_reason: A small creature with an upturned curling tail like a sting suggests a scorpion drawn as a lizard/dragon; not a lion (no mane), not a crab
img_396.rings: Central medallion with star and animal, inner ring, outer ring, plus an arc of figures at the top beyond the circle
img_396.figure_details: Nude women, standing at the top, lying or radial elsewhere; no tubs visible in the circle; each with a star
img_396.celestial_objects: About 30 stars plus one large central star; no sun or moon
img_396.groupings: Inner and outer rings, plus top arc
img_396.astro_concept: About 30 stars/figures: degrees of the sign or days of the month

img_489.description: Circular diagram on a right-hand page. Centre: a pale horned animal with curled horn reaching to a green plant, standing on a green mound with scalloped edge. Two rings of colourful clothed figures, many in tubs or boxes painted blue or green, each holding a star; text bands and labels.
img_489.central_figure: A pale goat- or ram-like animal with curved horns eating a green plant, on a green hill
img_489.sign_reason: Horned caprine land animal with no fish tail; a ram fits best, though it looks goat-like
img_489.rings: Central medallion, inner ring about 5 figures, outer ring about 10 figures, text on borders
img_489.figure_details: Clothed figures in red, green and blue, many emerging from rectangular tubs/boxes painted blue or green or striped; each holds a star on a string; lower ones inverted
img_489.celestial_objects: About 15 stars; no sun or moon
img_489.astro_concept: Fifteen figures: half of a sign's 30 degrees or a half-month
img_489.other: Very similar layout to img_896 and img_941

img_793.description: Circular diagram on a stained, faded page with a vertical fold. Centre: a lion-like four-legged animal with a large head and blue spots, a red mark on the body, with a plant behind it. Two rings of nude figures with stars plus figures above the circle; text bands.
img_793.central_figure: A lion- or big-cat-like animal with spotted coat, a plant behind it
img_793.sign_reason: Big-cat body and large head with mane-like outline indicate a lion
img_793.rings: Central medallion with circular text, inner ring, outer ring
img_793.figure_details: Nude women, standing at top, lying or radial elsewhere; no tubs; each with a star
img_793.celestial_objects: About 30 stars; no sun or moon
img_793.astro_concept: About 30 stars/figures: degrees of the sign or days of the month
img_793.other: Page is faded and stained; fold line crosses the left

img_476.description: Circular diagram on a right-hand page with part of another diagram on the left. Centre: a red horned animal with long tufted tail eating from a basket of green, on a green ground line. Two rings of nude or lightly clothed figures, some in tubs, each with a star. A hole in the parchment on the left of the inner ring.
img_476.central_figure: A red bull-like horned animal feeding from a basket
img_476.sign_reason: Heavy red bovine body, short horns and long tufted tail indicate a bull
img_476.rings: Central medallion, inner ring about 5 figures, outer ring about 10 figures; text on borders
img_476.figure_details: Mostly nude women, some emerging from tubs, some with caps; each holds a star on a string
img_476.celestial_objects: About 15 stars; some stars have faces drawn in them; no separate sun or moon
img_476.astro_concept: Fifteen figures: half a sign's 30 degrees, half a month
img_476.other: Hole in the vellum; a second diagram partly visible at left

img_991.description: Circular diagram on a left-hand page. Centre: a balance scale with two pans. Rings of nude female figures with stars, one wearing a crown; labels and text bands. Hole in the parchment at right.
img_991.central_figure: A pair of balance scales hanging from a post
img_991.sign_reason: The scales are the symbol of Libra
img_991.rings: Central medallion with text circle, inner ring, outer ring
img_991.figure_details: Nude women standing at top, lying or radial elsewhere; one wears a crown; no tubs; each with a star
img_991.celestial_objects: About 30 stars; no sun or moon
img_991.astro_concept: About 30 stars/figures: degrees of the sign or days of the month

img_972.description: Circular diagram on a wide fold-out page with parts of neighbouring diagrams at left and right. Centre: a man in green tunic and green cap holding hands with a woman in a long blue gown. Rings of nude and some clothed figures with stars; labels and text bands.
img_972.central_figure: A man and a woman standing together holding hands
img_972.sign_reason: A couple of two people together is the usual picture of the Twins (often shown as a man and woman)
img_972.rings: Central medallion, inner ring, outer ring
img_972.figure_details: Mostly nude women, a few clothed; some with caps; at the lower left a few appear to be in tubs or clothed; each with a star
img_972.celestial_objects: About 30 stars; no sun or moon
img_972.astro_concept: About 30 stars/figures: degrees of the sign or days of the month
img_972.other: Adjacent diagrams visible on a fold-out

img_241.description: Circular diagram on a fold-out page with a neighbouring diagram at left. Centre: two crayfish/lobster-like creatures, one pale green and one red. Rings of nude female figures with stars, labels, text bands.
img_241.central_figure: Two crustaceans (crayfish or lobsters), one green, one red
img_241.sign_reason: Crab or crayfish creatures are the standard Cancer emblem
img_241.rings: Central medallion, inner ring, outer ring
img_241.figure_details: Nude women, standing at top and lying or radial elsewhere; one with a crown-like headdress; no tubs; each with a star
img_241.celestial_objects: About 30 stars; no sun or moon
img_241.astro_concept: About 30 stars/figures: degrees of the sign or days of the month

recognise_source: yes: the zodiac section of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408)
